messages:
harper: opened a small PR to polish the model-catalog migration doc and update the nebula3b & aurorax model-cards. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/688
harper: highlights: replace curl examples with SDK v3 snippets, add a compact Dedicated runbook, correct embed-shard math, and pin bench rows to runner commit 2026-09-run1
mina: nice. can you put a single-sentence "tl;dr" at the top for customers scanning release notes? keeps support happy
harper: added: \"Catalog update: clarifies supported variants, updates long-context limits, and documents edge-quant KV eviction differences.\"
joel: regarding edge-quant, ops wanted a one-line forensic note that we can paste into replies
harper: added: \"edge-quant may evict oldest KV buckets at non-uniform boundaries vs classic quant; apps relying on KV lifetime should pin a compat or legacy variant.\"
arjun: saw the embed-shard example  the math originally used floor(). switch to ceil: (sum_tokens + shard_size - 1) // shard_size. also warn that token counts change per model
harper: updated math and added a short tokenize-before-shard note plus a python sketch:
```
# python (sketch)
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
texts = ["doc A...", "doc B..."]
# get model-specific token counts via API
counts = [c.tokenize(t) for t in texts]  # pseudocode
shard_size = 1500
num_shards = (sum(counts) + shard_size - 1) // shard_size  # ceil division
```
mina: good. can you also add a TS snippet for streaming using the v3 channel-style API? support needs an example they can paste
harper: added a compact TS streaming example:
```ts
import Redwood from "@redwood/inference"
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
for await (const part of client.chat.stream({ model: "nebula3b", messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Explain X" }] })) {
  process.stdout.write(part.delta ?? "")
}
```
joel: bench table: please include p95 and link to the exact runner commit so numbers don't drift. also note measurement conditions (reserved prefix 64, seq length 1024)
harper: pinned CSV to /benchmarks/nebula3b/2026-09-run1.csv and added table caption with runner ref and measurement notes
mina: docs-bot linkcheck flagged one anchor that will move when router notes are renamed. can we create a follow-up ticket rather than hold the PR?
pm-bot: created ticket platform#1042 to track runtime-router anchor rename and linked it to the docs PR
docs-bot: linkcheck: 1 unresolved anchor (runtime-router anchor), 1 external 404 fixed. re-run scheduled on merge
arjun: Dedicated customers asked for a 3-step runbook. make it super actionable: pin, mirror, contact support with metrics
harper: added "Dedicated quick runbook":
1) Pin your current model version in Console before updating catalog references.
2) Mirror ~1% production traffic to a test pool and validate latency/throughput.
3) If results differ, open a support ticket with runner commit + p95/p50 deltas and request reserved-pool sizing guidance.
mina: small doc nit: define max_seq vs effective_seq. users keep confusing them
harper: added a short clarification: "effective_seq = max_seq - reserved_prefix_tokens (e.g., system prompts)" and a tiny ascii example
joel: LGTM on content. please squash the small typo fix commits, then merge once docs-bot goes green and someone sanity-checks the TS snippet locally
harper: will squash and merge after docs-bot clears and Mina verifies the TS example. thanks all :sparkles:
